title: EU/EEA Local Storage with Enterprise Safeguards (Compliant)
description: Enterprise customer personal data stored within the European Union (eu-central-1 Frankfurt) with secondary backup in Ireland (eu-west-1), customer-managed KMS encryption, IAM RBAC, and CloudTrail auditing. No international transfer outside the EEA is involved.
notes: Test case demonstrating baseline GDPR compliance with localized EU sovereign hosting.

title: Cross-Border Sensitive Health Data Transfer without Authorization (Non-Compliant)
description: Patient biometric and diagnostic records originating in the European Union proposed for storage in US East (us-east-1) with NO Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs), NO verified adequacy decision, and disabled encryption.
notes: Test case showing severe violation of GDPR Chapter V and Article 9, plus HIPAA technical safeguards.

title: India DPDP Act Compliant Storage with Standard Contracts (Compliant)
description: Indian customer personal data hosted in AWS Mumbai (ap-south-1) with cross-region disaster recovery in Hyderabad (ap-south-2). Fully encrypted with AWS KMS and strict IAM roles adhering to DPDP Act 2023 Section 8(5).
notes: Demonstrates domestic Indian cloud data residency and reasonable security safeguards.

title: Weak Security Controls on Regulated Financial Records (Non-Compliant)
description: Financial and payment card records stored in US East (us-east-1) with unencrypted S3 storage and disabled audit logging, violating PCI-DSS and baseline safeguards.
notes: Demonstrates critical security safeguard deficiencies despite domestic US hosting.

title: Risky Secondary Backup to Foreign Region (Needs Review / Warning)
description: Indian customer data stored locally in Mumbai (ap-south-1) but cross-replicated to a foreign backup region (us-east-1 N. Virginia) without documented bilateral transfer authorization.
notes: Demonstrates secondary backup jurisdiction risk requiring explicit transfer justification.

title: Insufficient Information & Ambiguous Cross-Border Transfer (Needs Review)
description: Cross-border data movement initiated from an international entity to Tokyo (ap-northeast-1) where transfer mechanism is unverified and deployment details are incomplete, triggering mandatory human legal review.
notes: Demonstrates autonomous fallback to NEEDS_REVIEW when regulatory parameters are underspecified.
